heroes.name: Ramattra
heroes.summary: Quality-of-life UI improvements for Void Barrier enhance awareness during Nemesis Form without affecting raw power.

changes.note: Cooldown is now visible while Nemesis Form is active.

heroes.name: Brigitte
heroes.summary: The addition of an Inspire tracking element provides players with better feedback on their healing efficiency.

changes.note: Added a custom UI element showing how many allies are currently being healed by Inspire.
This UI element can be toggled on/off in Brigitte's Hero Options.

heroes.name: D.Va
heroes.summary: A reduction in impact damage for Micro Missiles noticeably lowers D.Va's burst potential against squishy targets.

changes.note: Impact damage reduced from 3 to 2.

heroes.name: Doomfist
heroes.summary: Massive buffs to cooldowns, healing ratios, and punch damage significantly increase his lethality and uptime in specialized modes.

changes.note: Camera lock and shockwave effects now trigger later to better align with the animation.
Added new visual and sound effects that play when Empowered Punch is about to time out.
[The Best Defense] now scales proportionally with the Passive Health Gain from Currency.
Cooldown reduced to 8s (Down from 10s).
Ally Healing increased to 20% (Up from 15%).
Overhealth Max Life Scaling increased to 10% (Up from 8%).
Level 3 Punch Bonus Damage increased to 50% (Up from 25%).
Bonus damage increased to 20 (Up from 10).

heroes.name: Junker Queen
heroes.summary: The increase to her wound self-healing multiplier provides Junker Queen with stronger frontline sustainability.

changes.note: (5v5 only) Wound damage self-healing multiplier increased from 2.25x to 2.5x.

heroes.name: Emre
heroes.summary: Reductions to both healing conversion and explosion radius weaken Emre's ability to stabilize and control territory.

changes.note: Healing conversion reduced from 80% to 60%.
Radius of maximum explosion damage reduced from 2 to 1.5 meters.

heroes.name: Freja
heroes.summary: Adjustments to mobility and ultimate generation are counterbalanced by significant nerfs to spread and healing efficiency.

changes.note: No longer reduces the height gained from Updraft.
Cooldown reduced from 12 to 10 seconds.
Bonus Ultimate charge increased from 25% to 33%.
Decreased Currency from Healing and Damage by 5%.
Spread of extra bolts increased by 66%.
Max Life Healing reduced to 4% (Down from 6%).

heroes.name: Sierra
heroes.summary: A minor audio tweak to reduce auditory clutter without impacting mechanical performance.

changes.note: Weapon fire volume reduced.

heroes.name: Pharah
heroes.summary: Significant flat damage reductions across her rockets severely impact her ability to secure key eliminations.

changes.note: Damage reduced from 50 to 30.
Damage reduced per rocket from 40 to 30.

heroes.name: Baptiste
heroes.summary: Buffs to both instant healing and healing-over-time, paired with a lower cooldown, make Baptiste a sustain powerhouse.

changes.note: Instant healing increased from 40 to 50.
Healing over time increased from 40 to 50.
Cooldown reduced from 14 to 12 seconds.

heroes.name: Illari
heroes.summary: Removing the base projectile size increases the skill floor, requiring much higher precision for consistent damage.

changes.note: Base projectile size reduced from 0.05 to 0.
Hitscan Global Projectile Size Bonus still applies (0.07).

heroes.name: Kiriko
heroes.summary: The removal of the cleanse healing bonus makes Protection Suzu strictly a defensive utility rather than a health recovery tool.

changes.note: Additional healing after negative status cleanse removed (was 30).

heroes.name: Lúcio
heroes.summary: Trading substantial Sound Barrier strength for improved personal healing shifts his role towards survivability over team utility.

changes.note: Overhealth granted reduced from 750 to 625.
Duration reduced from 6 to 5 seconds.
Passive self-healing penalty is now correctly at 60% (was 70%).

heroes.name: Mercy
heroes.summary: Increased range and speed for Guardian Angel further enhance Mercy's already high mobility and evasiveness.

changes.note: Removed.
New.
Guardian Angel's range is increased by 30%.
Launch speed increased by 10%. (Reverted to previous value)

heroes.name: Mizuki
heroes.summary: A significant utility buff to Kekkai Sanctuary is checked by reductions in its healing output and active duration.

changes.note: Now absorbs enemy projectiles exiting the Sanctuary in addition to enemy projectiles entering the Sanctuary.
Healing over time reduced from 50/s to 40/s.
Duration reduced from 7 to 6 seconds.

heroes.name: Wuyang
heroes.summary: A decrease in peak damage is offset by much better ability uptime and a necessary fix to armor interactions.

changes.note: Fixed an issue where armor's damage reduction was being applied twice to Xuanwu Staff orbs.
Bonus Orb Damage decreased to 30% (Down from 40%).
Cooldown reduced to 10s (Down from 15s).

heroes.name: Reinhardt
heroes.summary: Slower barrier regeneration increases the window of vulnerability for Reinhardt's team during shield downtime.

changes.note: Barrier Healing per 1s decreased to 3% of Max Life (Down from 5%).

heroes.name: Reaper
heroes.summary: The redesign of Dire Triggers provides Reaper with more versatility against airborne and mid-range targets.

changes.note: Reworked to "[Dire Triggers] deals 30(AP) additional damage over 3s to Airborne enemies and to enemies beyond 8m."
New.
After use an ability or reloading, refresh cooldown of [Dire Triggers].
Removed.

heroes.name: Soldier: 76
heroes.summary: Reduced Biotic Field effectiveness for Overhealth specifically targets his survivability in complex team compositions.

changes.note: Applied reduced effectiveness of Biotic Fields spawned via Hunker Down (50%) to Overhealth.

heroes.name: Vendetta
heroes.summary: Increased currency scaling accelerates Vendetta's power curve in resource-based game modes.

changes.note: Increased Currency gain from Healing and Damage by 5%.

heroes.name: Jetpack Cat
heroes.summary: A massive list of buffs and new ability interactions turn Jetpack Cat into a high-utility mobility threat.

changes.note: When [Purr] ends, all other allies within [Purr]'s radius gain Overhealth equal to 40% of damage dealt during [Purr] and 10% to yourself for 3s.
[Purr] persists 15% longer for each ally or enemy currently affected by [Purr], up to 75%. Amount of healing pulses resets every 4 pulses.
Enemies within your [Purr] take damage equal to 30% of its healing.

heroes.name: Zenyatta
heroes.summary: Reducing the healing conversion from damage dealt lowers Zenyatta's personal and team sustain during aggressive plays.

changes.note: Healing from damage dealt decreased to 20% (Down from 30%).
